scope: Vocabulary and factual attributes only; this file contains no authorization decision rule or realized task outcome.

principal_classes.description: A named human operator associated with one tenant.
A named human auditor associated with one tenant.
A named service principal associated with one tenant.
A named reviewer without a tenant association.

proposition_classes.description: Assertion that a candidate canonical incident record satisfies the semantic record contract.
Assertion that a candidate reservation result and post-state satisfy the factual action contract.

action_classes.description: Decrease available inventory and create an applied reservation.
Release an applied reservation and restore its inventory quantity.

institutional_facts: Every listed principal identity is legitimate for purposes of authoring an ex ante rule.
Tenant association and principal class are public factual attributes.
Action requests record both actor_principal_id and target tenant_id.
Semantic propositions may be produced without changing ledger state.
Reservation actions may change ledger state even when a separate authorization evaluation later finds the actor nonconforming.
Correctness and authorization are distinct dimensions.
open_normative_boundary: A separate custodian must decide ex ante which principal classes may make which proposition or action classes under which tenant relation.
